maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new construction projects: pipelines, power plants, renewables, transmission, and communications infrastructure builds, rather than repair or replacement of existing installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private utilities, pipeline operators, telecom carriers, and power developers, not government agencies.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through organic project work across utility, pipeline, and communications segments, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Construction contractor bid project by project; customers can switch to other contractors between projects without major disruption.

notes: Judged partly from prior knowledge of MasTec's customer mix; website text doesn't state it.
